latest.summary_excerpt: In this Help Net Security interview, Lindsay Kaye, VP of Threat Intelligence at HUMAN Security, talks about what AI-generated malware looks like on the bench. latest.summary_excerpt: Container security has a familiar problem. Teams identify vulnerabilities, but turning those findings into lower risk is much harder. A standard container image may include operating-system packages, development tools, debugging utilities and libraries that an application never uses. Each unnecessary component can expand the attack surface and add vulnerabilities to investigate, patch or explain during an audit. hottest.title: ランサム攻撃で身代金を払う企業・払わない企業の違いとは？　オランダ警察などが約700件の記録から分析
hottest.summary_excerpt: オランダ警察や英エディンバラ大学などに所属する研究者らが発表した論文「You Can’t Talk Your Way Out of Cyber Extortion: An Empirical Study of Ransomware Negotiations」は、ランサムウェア攻撃における犯行グループとの値引き交渉の実態と、身代金の支払いを決定づける要因を明らかにした研究報告だ。

Node-RED is a flow-based programming tool built on Node.js that lets users wire together event-driven applications in a browser-based editor. persistent_hot.title: CVE-2026-118527: Ivanti Connect Secure
persistent_hot.summary_excerpt: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357.

persistent_hot.title: CVE-2026-111357: Ivanti Connect Secure
persistent_hot.summary_excerpt: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

persistent_hot.title: CVE-2026-97229: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition
persistent_hot.summary_excerpt: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.
